The factory output risk calculation succeeded with a perfect verifier reward, demonstrating a robust implementation of the weighted assessment logic.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and passed the legacy pytest suite in test_output.py without exceptions. While successful, LiteLLM warnings regarding missing 'botocore' modules suggest potential environment dependencies to monitor if scaling to cloud runtimes. The results were successfully serialized to result.json after a 3m 33s runtime.
